corpusDescription: One sequential performance-only pass after root tests/builds completed. The fixed 52 diagnostic and 24 capacity inputs plus two boundary inputs at 199,900 normalized JSON characters each. No model/wire choices depend on these measurements. Cold first-sample costs are included; assets are preloaded, and each encode/decode rebuilds/reprimes its model. Peak RSS covers the entire Node worker, dependencies/WASM, heaps and garbage collection. Not a mobile or universal worst-case guarantee. Overbudget fragment outputs are decoded solely for correctness using the benchmark override. The Node harness does not enforce the browser Worker 60-second timeout.
measurement: Every character in the complete URL-serialized Markdown link is counted. Only exact normalized-envelope round trips count as successful. codec is transport metadata; all other schema fields and UTF-16 code units are compared.

variants.label: main
variants.wasmLoading: The unchanged brotli-wasm ESM/browser binary is read locally through a file: fetch adapter. No native-zlib substitute.

variants.timing: One ordered pass including cold first-sample costs; indicative CPU timings, not a statistically repeated latency benchmark.
